welcome:
Welcome to the Tekton CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore a simulated Tekton Pipelines cluster.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

scenarios.title: Run and Debug a CI Pipeline

steps.instruction: List all available pipelines in the cluster to see what's configured.
Start the 'build-and-deploy' pipeline with the git revision parameter.
steps.hint: Try: tkn pipeline start build-and-deploy -p git-revision=main

steps.instruction: List recent pipeline runs to find the one you just triggered.
The run 'build-and-deploy-run-7x9k2' has Failed. Check its logs.
Get more details on the failed run to see which task failed.
The 'run-tests' task failed. Check the task run logs directly.
The tests were flaky. Cancel any in-progress runs and re-run the pipeline.
steps.hint: Try: tkn pipeline start build-and-deploy -p git-revision=main --use-param-defaults

steps.instruction: Verify the new run is progressing successfully.
Search Tekton Hub for a git-clone task to reuse.
Install the git-clone task from the hub.
steps.hint: Try: tkn hub install task git-clone

steps.instruction: Verify the task was installed by listing all tasks.
Describe the git-clone task to see its parameters and workspaces.
Now list pipelines to confirm our new pipeline was applied via kubectl.
Check the trigger templates that will start our pipeline on git push.
Verify the event listener is running and ready to receive webhooks.
Start the pipeline manually to test it end-to-end.
steps.expect: tkn pipeline start build-test-deploy -p repo-url=https://github.com/org/app.git -p image=registry.io/org/app:latest
steps.hint: Try: tkn pipeline start build-test-deploy -p repo-url=https://github.com/org/app.git -p image=registry.io/org/app:latest
